items.description: Exactly one entry per item shown, in the order given.

id.description: The item's id as shown, e.g. "a03".

difficulty.description: How hard it is for a reviewer who already understands the case to check this item's call: how unclear the comparison is. Not how close the description is to the court defect, not whether the call is right, and not how hard the case is.

score.description: An integer from 1 to 10, using the whole range. 1-3 easy (1-2: plain at a glance; 3: one more look needed), 4-6 intermediate, 7-10 hard (9-10: two careful reviewers could reasonably decide it differently). Must agree with `difficulty`.

estimated_minutes.description: Minutes a reviewer who already understands the case needs to reach a decision on this item. Only the work this item adds.

reason.description: One or two sentences specific to this item: the step that takes the work, and the words, claim or court defect it turns on.
